subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Reluctant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Enthusiastic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reluctant"** means unwilling and hesitant; disinclined. (अनिच्छुक)

 
 
• **Example:** She was reluctant to join the meeting because she was not prepared.
 
 
 
• **"Enthusiastic"** refers to showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. (उत्साही)
 
 
• **Example:** He was enthusiastic about starting his new job next week.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Reluctant'** is **'Enthusiastic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Enthusiastic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Desperate** (बेकरार): Desperate means feeling a strong need or urgency, often because of hopelessness or distress.

 It expresses emotional intensity or anxious urgency, not willingness.
 
 
• **Example:** She was desperate to find a job after months of unemployment.
 
 
 
• **Obedient** (आज्ञाकारी): Obedient means following orders, not necessarily willingly. 
 
 
• **Example:** The obedient dog followed all the commands of its owner.
 
 
 
• **Beautiful** (सुंदर): Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.
 
 
• **Example:** The beautiful sunset left everyone in awe.
